articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) (“Mawson” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: MIGI) today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) unanimously adopted a limited-duration stockholder rights agreement (the “Rights Agreement”) to protect the best interests of Mawson stockholders.
